cloudflare_edge.rule: Expose dashboards only through identity, policy, and tunnel controls.

proxmox_contained.rule: Contain observability workloads when isolation or lab routing is required.

non_collapse_rule: Local, Cloudflare, and Proxmox modes may be used interchangeably, but they must remain distinguishable by route, receipt, and exposure boundary.
doctrine: Observe the body. Do not become the body. Host executes. AEUSB carries. Host does not own.
